vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain permission requests and distinguish pending requests from signed permissions.
requirements.zh: 维护许可申请，并区分待处理申请与已签署许可。

requirements.en: Accurately record contractual territories, dates and performance-count limits.
requirements.zh: 准确记录合同中的适用地区、日期及演出场次限制。

requirements.en: Track expiries and raise discrepancies in planned performance scope.
requirements.zh: 跟踪到期事项，并上报计划演出范围中的差异。

requirements.en: Maintain controlled document access and a traceable permissions index.
requirements.zh: 维护受控文档访问及可追溯许可索引。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently negotiate performance-license commercial terms.
requirements.zh: 优先：能够独立协商演出许可的商业条款。
